notes.subject: gabish
notes.rationale: וגביש: sam man i tok em i grystal (klia olsem ais), sam man i tok em i wanpela ston — em i tok mana, olsem KJV 'pearls'

notes.subject: ומשך
notes.rationale: םשך i gat planti mining: 'kisim/senim', 'wok long autim'; ylt 'acquisition', kjv 'price'

notes.subject: מפנינים
notes.rationale: פנינים: 'pen' o 'ston red (ruby)' — ol taim i wok long tambuim long taim bilong ol man i lainim

translation: Koral na gabish — ol i no tingim ⟨ol⟩ long holim wanem, na kisim bilong hahama i antap long ol pen.
